record.title: Serum erythropoietin levels in babesia affected dogs
record.journal: International Journal of Advanced Biochemistry Research
record.abstract: Canine babesiosis is a hemoprotozoan disease characterized by anemia leading to hypoxia. The present study aimed to estimate serum EPO levels in Babesia-infected dogs using a canine-specific ELISA kit.
